name: Real estate

bnote.681001: India has no listed residential-rental company. These are two large US apartment REITs.
bnote.681002: India's three listed office REITs and two listed coworking operators.
bnote.681004: Nexus Select is India's listed mall REIT; Phoenix Mills runs malls.
bnote.681008: Mid-size Indian developers. The largest developers are listed under construction (Section E).
bnote.682100: No listed Indian property broker. CBRE and JLL are the largest worldwide.

flags.embassy: REIT profit is reduced by depreciation and fair-value items; investors usually look at distributions instead of P/E.
flags.wework: Lease costs are booked below EBITDA under IND AS 116, which makes the EBITDA margin look very high.
flags.awfis: Lease costs are booked below EBITDA under IND AS 116, which makes the EBITDA margin look high.

notes: Offices and malls are covered by Indian REITs. Residential rental and brokerage use US companies.
